# Lucent UI

> An AI-first React component library where every component ships with a machine-readable COMPONENT_MANIFEST — so AI coding assistants generate correct, on-brand UI the first time.

Lucent UI is an open-source React component library built for AI-assisted development. Each of the 52+ components includes a structured manifest (COMPONENT_MANIFEST) describing props, design intent, usage examples, and accessibility requirements. AI assistants read these manifests to generate correct code without hallucinated prop names or incorrect variants.

## Key Features

- 28 atom components (Button, Input, Toggle, Badge, Chip, SegmentedControl, ColorPicker, etc.)
- 24 molecule components (Card, Tabs, DataTable, CommandPalette, DatePicker, Timeline, Menu, etc.)
- 8 composition recipes (Profile Card, Settings Panel, Search/Filter Bar, etc.)
- 10 curated design presets (Modern, Liquid Glass, Brutalist, Terminal, Soft UI, Minimal, etc.)
- createTheme() — derive 40+ tokens from 9 brand colors using perceptual contrast
- MCP Server — connect AI assistants via Model Context Protocol for full manifest access
- LucentDevTools — live token editor toggled with Cmd+Shift+D
- Zero CSS-in-JS — inline styles + CSS custom properties only
- React 18 and 19 compatible

## Installation

```
npm install lucent-ui
```

## Quick Start

```jsx
import { LucentProvider, Button } from 'lucent-ui';

<LucentProvider preset="modern">
  <Button variant="primary">Hello, world</Button>
</LucentProvider>
```

## MCP Server

Add to your AI assistant's MCP config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lucent-ui": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["lucent-ui-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```
